patthana21.21:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu savitakka savicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.21:2.1: na hetuṃ na avitakka vicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca hetu avitakka vicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
